svg.text: Wiki pages are written BEFORE prediction reads them — the knowledge-accretion loop working, rather than one day stale.
So steps 10–12 and step 16 must not be reordered or parallelised: step 16 reads what step 12 wrote.

Gate G4 — the leakage harness — must be green before ANY scored prediction.
Under forward-only a leaked prediction cannot be re-run. There is no second attempt at a live day (REQ-1212).
Failure handling — the rule is: never invent a value; always keep a value that was honestly produced (Design §7)
